errors.what: patch-data rejected inline JSON arg (expects a file path / `-` for stdin); os error 123
errors.recovered_by: re-ran piping the JSON via stdin with `-` as the JSON_FILE arg

problems_and_friction: patch-data takes a JSON_FILE arg, not inline JSON, so the first invocation failed; piping through stdin with `-` worked. Both target fields were data-bound, so patch-data alone effected the change with no pack-html.
context_understood: Flip a data-bound verdict from HubSpot to Zoho CRM and replace verdict_rationale with supplied text via a single patch-data merge, then validate and snapshot.
